description: Search open grant opportunities in the GrantSonar corpus (federal, state, and foundation grants). Uses semantic similarity over a plain-English description of the project or need, with a keyword fallback. Returns title, agency, deadline, award amounts, similarity score, and a GrantSonar URL per hit.

query.description: Plain-English description of the project, organization, or funding need (e.g. "after-school STEM programs for rural Missouri students").

name: search_grants
